ShortDescription.Value: Visualize the true reach of your city's services and passive auras. Area of Effect provides butter-smooth, real-time radius overlays for your buildings with absolutely zero impact on your frame rate.

Publish.LongDescription:
# Area of Effect - Real-Time Auras and Influence Visualization
Take the guesswork out of city planning. Area of Effect renders the exact influence radii, passive auras, and road network coverage for your buildings, letting you optimize service coverage, land value, and district layouts with precision.
# What's New in v1.0.2
- **Presets System**: Save and load up to 5 custom configurations of active layers, colors, and settings. - **Interactive UI**: Main panel and Mini-Inspector window positions now persist across game launches. - **High Visibility Mode**: Scale up floating stat bubbles and boost contrast for easier reading. - **Mini-Inspector**: Hover or select any building to see exact active ranges and modifiers in a compact pop-up. - **Corrected Upgrades Overlay**: Overlays now correctly center on the parent building when upgrades or sub-buildings are selected. - **Clean Road Network Filter**: Exact Polygon searches now follow real roads only, ignoring utility lines. - **Floating Stats in All Modes**: 3D stat bubbles now display in both standard and Exact Polygon visualization modes.
# Key Features
- **Multiple Visualization Modes**: Classic Rings, Neon Rings, Soft Glow, Roads Only, Exact Polygon (BFS Isochrone), and Cached Heatmap. - **Passive Auras vs. Service Radii**: Visualize radial aura modifiers like Well-being alongside road-based services like Police, Fire, Education, Health, and Deathcare. - **Floating 3D Stats Overlay**: Floating bubbles above buildings show exactly which service modifiers are applied to them. - **Native Engine Integration**: Draws natively in 3D space using the game's OverlayRenderSystem for pixel-perfect camera scaling. - **Uncompromising Performance**: Fully Burst-compiled Unity jobs. Virtually zero CPU overhead and no UI thread hitching.
